data.set_v2_3_caveats: ADR 0010: salaried pay is identical to the cent; no sensitive merchants (the probe below adds them); drift scored per applicant; no cross-applicant code statistics

selection.method: ground truth only, never an engine's output; each rule takes the lowest applicant id that meets it
selection.bpay: No scenario has a liability repaid by BPAY, so no scenario's liabilities depend on the ENR-28 fix (BPAY bill payments returned as transfers by Enrich 1.7.0). BPAY bill payments for utilities and the like may still appear, and are affected by ENR-28 until the fixed build is pinned.

A.rule: regular salary, affordable: a CDR feed of 6 months or more; tags salaried-fixed and dishonour-clean and none of the risk tags; the salary account shared; every liability declared; no liability repaid by BPAY; truth surplus at or above the set's median
A.truth_summary: salaried-fixed; one declared loan (MONEY3, direct debit); 12 months; truth surplus 3775.86 a month

B.story: a hidden credit liability and affordability pressure
B.rule: a hidden credit liability and affordability pressure: a CDR feed of 6 months or more; tag salaried and none of the drift or gambling tags; the salary account shared; an undisclosed personal or car loan; no liability repaid by BPAY; truth surplus at or below the set's lower quartile
B.truth_summary: salaried, irregular, with overtime; one undisclosed personal loan (COMMBANK PL, direct debit); 6 months; truth surplus 238.59 a month

C.rule: missing income or insufficient evidence: a CDR feed of 3 months or more, tag salaried, no liability repaid by BPAY, whose salary account is not shared (EQ-01 then fails, and the assessment is unverified)
C.truth_summary: salaried-fixed; salary account not shared; 12 months

D.rule: a detected undisclosed liability (ruling 40776, 1): tag salaried and none of the drift or gambling tags; at least one undisclosed BNPL, SACC, wage advance or credit card, repaid by direct debit or card (repayment_channel DIRECT_DEBIT or PAYMENT; not BPAY) from a shared account; not scenario A, B or C
D.channel_mapping: set v2.3's repayment_channel is DIRECT_DEBIT, BPAY or PAYMENT. The ruling's 'direct debit or card, not BPAY' is read as DIRECT_DEBIT or PAYMENT; PAYMENT is the generator's plain card or account payment, its only channel that is neither a direct debit nor BPAY
D.truth_summary: salaried, irregular, with a bonus; one undisclosed wage advance, repaid fortnightly by direct debit from a shared account (15 repayments), to a lender held out of the lender lists (truth tag unseen-lenders); 12 months; CDR feed; salary account shared; truth surplus 6321.84 a month
D.disclosure: D is an example of a liability type the engine is designed to find. On synthetic set v2.2, LIA 1.3.6 found 0.4498 of undisclosed liabilities (about 45%), with pinned Enrich 1.8.0 (SIG-83 run 2, baseline arm, b1cb660). That is synthetic performance, not real-world detection performance (ruling 40776, 1)
D.selected: 2026-11-27, by src/research/sig76/scenarios.ts (selectScenarios), before any candidate or expected result is computed
D.note_40787: D stays as committed and is shown as computed. Its lender carries the set's unseen-lenders truth tag, so it is outside the engine's lender list by the set's design, and will most likely not be detected. Cause, owned by the architect: 40776's wording didn't exclude unseen lenders (ruling 40787, 1). The demo shows D as the limit on lenders the engine doesn't know

D2.story: a detected undisclosed liability, from a lender the engine is designed to know
D2.rule: D's rule (ruling 40776, 1), and the applicant doesn't carry the unseen-lenders truth tag (ruling 40787, 2); not scenario A, B, C or D
D2.truth_summary: salaried, irregular, with a bonus; an undisclosed BNPL (AFTERPAY), repaid fortnightly by direct debit from a shared account (13 repayments), which meets D's rule; also an undisclosed credit card (ANZ) paid from an unshared account (no repayment in the feed; truth tag repaid-from-unshared) and a declared wage advance (BEFOREPAY, direct debit, shared); 6 months; CDR feed; salary account shared; truth surplus 935.79 a month

amendment.reason: ruling 40787, 2: D's rule (40776) was meant to capture a liability type the engine is designed to find, and its wording didn't exclude unseen lenders; D's selected applicant carries the unseen-lenders truth tag. D2 adds that exclusion. D is kept and shown as computed
amendment.seen_before_rule: D's selection (syn-v23-039cb4ba308a6197) and its unseen-lenders truth tag were seen, in ground truth, before D2's rule was written
amendment.engine_output_note: no engine output for any scenario had been computed when D2's rule was written; the expected states withdrawn by ruling 40745, 2 (A to C, on #58) predate D and D2 and are not carried here

D2.disclosure: D2 is an example of a liability type the engine is designed to find. On synthetic set v2.2, LIA 1.3.6 found 0.4498 of undisclosed liabilities (about 45%), with pinned Enrich 1.8.0 (SIG-83 run 2, baseline arm, b1cb660). That is synthetic performance, not real-world detection performance (ruling 40776, 1)
D2.not_evidence: D2 demonstrates the capability; it is not evidence for H2 (rulings 40776, 1 and 40787, 2)
D2.selected: 2026-11-27, by src/research/sig76/scenarios.ts (selectScenarios), before any engine output is computed

requests.recorded: 2026-11-27, before any expected state is computed (rulings 40730 and 40732; Colin's answers of 27 November: the proposed defaults, with the expense method observed)

sources.loan: proposed by engineering and accepted by Colin: a personal loan of $20,000 over 60 months at 11.5%, the same for every scenario so the scenarios differ only in their data
sources.policy: AF-T1's policy (test/fixtures/af-t1.json): buffer 3%, floor 5.5%, card commitment factor 0.03; shading is INC's default (src/engines/families/inc/config.ts, INC_DEFAULTS.shading)
sources.expense_method: observed (ruling 40745, 1, superseding 40738's AF-E3 default): observed (AF-E1, AF-E2): committed plus basic spending from the transactions, categorised on the pinned Enrich build. AF-E3's default needs confirmed expenses and a benchmark; the synthetic applications have no confirmed expenses and no seed benchmark rows exist, and X-2 never replaces a missing input, so every scenario would be unverified (Colin, 27 November)
sources.benchmark: none: the observed method doesn't read one
sources.as_of_and_lookback: set v2.3's as-of date (manifest) and the default 6-month lookback (D22)
sources.enrich: no Enrich tenant; the local path, forced (D58); the feed is synthetic, so it never goes to the API (D42)
sources.application: each applicant's own application from set v2.3 (stated gross income and declared liabilities), unchanged

requests.enrich_mark: renamed 27 November, before any expected state: SIG-70's follow-up (O4) replaced the request's `synthetic: true` with `real_consented: false` (SIG-82 40765, #62). The meaning is unchanged: the feed is synthetic, so it never reaches the API (D42)

negative_control.expect: the assessment is unverified, or evidence incomplete, with no guessed income figure. If it isn't, stop (SIG-76 T2)

perturbation.change: scenario A's most recent salary credit increased by $100.00, nothing else changed
perturbation.expect: the hosted result differs from scenario A's (SIG-76 T4: no hard-coded output)

negative_paths.expired_invite: an invite past its expiry: the applicant can't connect, and the lender sees it expired (T9)
negative_paths.revoked_grant: a grant revoked after connection: no new data is read, and the state shows revoked (T9)
negative_paths.cross_tenant_read: a tenant-B key reading tenant A's applicant and assessment gets 404 (T6, RLS)
negative_paths.billing_out_of_scope: billing (SIG-67) is not built: the over-limit and insufficient-balance invites are shown as out of scope, not tested
negative_paths.sensitive_probe: scenario A's applicant with added lines: a SACC narrative "IV<ZWSP>F NIMBLE REPAY" and card spend at "CARDIOLOGY CLINIC" with MCC 8011; no keyword or fragment shows anywhere, JSON, UI or PDF (T5)

procedure: on the hosted demo stage, at the candidate commit: a lender signs in, creates an applicant and sends an invite
the applicant completes the labelled sandbox consent
transactions are ingested and categorised by local Enrich, path recorded
the assessment completes, and its JSON (summary, affordability, signals and evidence) is fetched, with the PDF and webhook if in scope
each scenario is repeated three times from a clean state
the run record goes under research/runs/ with the commit, environment, set hash and versions (definitions, thresholds, taxonomy, keyword list, LIA, INC, EQ)

expected_states.computed: 2026-11-27, on main d303279 (review 21: fit; ruling 40787, 4), by scripts/sig76-expected.ts, C first (unverified, so the run continued), then A, B, D and D2

out_of_scope: the real openfeed and live Enrich API paths
